name: Caerulescent-Novena

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: They dwell in pressure-keeps beneath the ice, mining heat from the mantle seams.

description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a binary sunset, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Settlement lights trace the coastlines and river-veins, visible from high orbit.
Debris from the starship crash site (colony ship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Relatives of the lost still charter quiet ships to fly the debris fan. Sometimes they hire escorts. Sometimes they need them.
